onboarding.title: Onboarding — {{username}}
onboarding.alertShare: Share these credentials with the admin to set up their EZKey mobile app.
onboarding.previewNotice: Technology preview: this dialog shows the enrollment proof token, binding challenge, and QR together for convenience. Ezkey does not automatically deliver email or SMS in this flow yet. This hosted build is a demonstrator, not a production security baseline. Until dedicated integrations exist, capture the QR with your usual tool, send the image to the new admin through your usual channel, and send the 6-digit binding challenge in a separate SMS through your usual operator process.

deactivate.title: Deactivate Admin
deactivate.confirmMessage: Are you sure you want to deactivate {{username}}? All active tokens will be revoked immediately.
deactivate.cannotUndo: This action cannot be undone from this interface.

detail.title: Admin — {{username}}
detail.reissueActivationCodeIntro: Generate a new one-time activation code. The new code will be shown once and cannot be retrieved again after you close this dialog.
detail.reissueActivationCodeWarningTitle: Any previous unused activation code stops working immediately.
detail.reissueActivationCodeWarningBody: The administrator stays pending until the new code is consumed. Deliver the new code through a secure channel.
detail.errorRecoveryCodesIssue: Failed to issue initial recovery codes.
detail.issueInitialRecoveryCodesIntro: Generate the first set of recovery codes for this administrator. The codes will be shown once and cannot be displayed again after you close this dialog.
detail.issueInitialRecoveryCodesWarningTitle: These recovery codes will be shown only once.
detail.issueInitialRecoveryCodesWarningBody: Save them now in a secure location. They cannot be retrieved again after you close this dialog.
detail.regenerateRecoveryCodesIntro: Generate a new set of recovery codes for this administrator. The new codes will be shown once.
detail.regenerateRecoveryCodesWarningTitle: Previous unused recovery codes are revoked immediately.
detail.regenerateRecoveryCodesWarningBody: Save the new codes now. The old unused codes no longer work and the new codes cannot be shown again after you close this dialog.
detail.recoveryCodesTitle: Recovery codes (save now — single use each)
detail.recoveryCodesHint: Each code works once. They cannot be shown again from this console after you close this dialog.
detail.recoveryCodesSavedConfirmLabel: I have saved these recovery codes in a secure location
detail.pendingActivationNotice: This administrator is pending activation. The first enrollment will only be created when the activation code is consumed. Recovery codes are issued later from the authenticated admin-management flow.

operationalWarning.tenantInactive: This admin's tenant is currently inactive. Login attempts by this admin will be rejected until the tenant is reactivated.

contextHelp.deactivateContent: Deactivating an admin immediately revokes all their active sessions and blocks future logins. This action is intended for departures, policy violations, or security incidents. A reason is recommended for audit purposes. The account can be reactivated by a Global Admin.

create.activationCodeHint: Deliver this code through a secure channel. It is used for first-time setup and cannot be retrieved again from this console.
create.activationCodeWarningTitle: This is the only time you will see this activation code.
create.activationCodeWarningBody: Copy it now and deliver it securely. It cannot be retrieved after this dialog is closed.
create.activationCodeSavedConfirmLabel: I have saved this activation code in a secure location
create.activationCodeSuccessHint: This administrator remains pending activation until the code is consumed. Enrollment credentials and recovery codes do not exist yet.
create.recoveryCodesTitle: Recovery codes (save now — single use each)
create.recoveryCodesHint: Each code works once. They cannot be shown again from this console after you close this dialog.
create.recoveryCodesWarningTitle: This is the only time you will see these recovery codes.
create.recoveryCodesWarningBody: Copy them now and store them securely. They cannot be retrieved after this dialog is closed.
create.recoveryCodesSavedConfirmLabel: I have saved these recovery codes in a secure location
create.successHint: Use the Credentials button in the list to retrieve the onboarding token and QR code to share with the new admin. Recovery codes are not created yet and should be issued later from the authenticated admin-management flow after first sign-in.
create.onboardingModeImmediateHelp: Creates the first enrollment immediately. Recovery codes are not created during bootstrap and must be issued later from the authenticated admin-management flow after first sign-in.
create.onboardingModeActivationCodeHelp: Creates the administrator in pending activation and returns a one-time activation code to deliver separately.
